$comment: Every .web.* sibling the Route A web build resolves ahead of its native file. One entry per documented React Native Web gap; config/scripts/mobile-web-app-web-overrides.test.mjs fails on an unlisted one, a listed file that is gone, or one with no native sibling.

overrides.reason: The page has no websocket transport and no pairing keychain. This is the single transport substitution point: a placeholder RpcClient until C0.4 lands BridgeRpcClient over the shell bridge.
expo-secure-store resolves to {} on web, and the bridge carries the RPC, so the page holds no device token.
